notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective July 1, 1988, see section 6303 of Pub. L. 100–297, set out as an Effective Date of 1988 Amendment note under section 1071 of this title.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 98–377, title VI, § 601, Aug. 11, 1984, 98 Stat. 1295, which provided that title VI of Pub. L. 98–377 was to be cited as the “Excellence in Education Act”, was repealed by Pub. L. 100–297, title II, § 2303, Apr. 28, 1988, 102 Stat. 324.
